about: Every refusal of the .xlsx reader by name (ADR-0330 sections 4 and 9): a file that is not a plain .xlsx, a part that declares a DTD or is not well-formed, a cell or style out of place, and a file past a limit, refused with their reason and the part, the Sheet and the cell they met. Transcribed from ExGrid.Data.Xlsx's RefusalTests and RowAndColumnFormatTests.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: bytes that are not a zip are refused

refused.message: The file is not a zip package, so it is not an .xlsx.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: an empty file is refused, saying it is empty

refused.message: The file is empty.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: a zip's signature on bytes that are not a zip is refused

refused.message: The file is not a zip package that can be read: End of Central Directory record could not be found.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: a zip that is another Office document is refused as not a workbook

zip:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types">
  <Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>
  <Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>
  <Override PartName="/word/document.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml"/>
  <Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/>
  
</Types>

refused.message: Part 'word/document.xml': The package's document is 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml', not a workbook: the file is not an .xlsx.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: a zip that is no Office document is refused as not a workbook

refused.message: The zip package has no [Content_Types].xml, so it is not an Office document.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: a workbook with macros (.xlsm) is refused by its content type

zip:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types">
  <Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>
  <Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>
  <Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.macroEnabled.main+xml"/>
  <Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/>
  <Default Extension="bin" ContentType="application/vnd.ms-office.vbaProject"/>
</Types>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<workbook xmlns="{Main}" xmlns:r="{Rel}"><sheets><sheet name="Sheet1" sheetId="1" r:id="rId1"/></sheets></workbook>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">
  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="{Rel}/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet1.xml"/>
  
</Relationships>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<worksheet xmlns="{Main}" xmlns:r="{Rel}"><sheetData><row r="1"><c r="A1"><v>1</v></c></row></sheetData></worksheet>

refused.message: Part 'xl/workbook.xml': The file is a workbook with macros (.xlsm), which is not read. Save it from Excel as an Excel Workbook (.xlsx), which leaves the macros out.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: a binary workbook (.xlsb) is refused, though its content type also says macro-enabled

zip:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types">
  <Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>
  <Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>
  <Override PartName="/xl/workbook.bin" ContentType="application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.binary.macroEnabled.main"/>
  <Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/>
  
</Types>

refused.message: Part 'xl/workbook.bin': The file is an Excel Binary Workbook (.xlsb), not an .xlsx. Save it from Excel as an Excel Workbook (.xlsx).

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: an Excel 97-2003 workbook (.xls), an OLE compound file, is refused as legacy

refused.message: The file is an Excel 97–2003 workbook (.xls), or another Office binary file, not an .xlsx. Save it from Excel as an Excel Workbook (.xlsx).

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: an encrypted workbook, an OLE compound file holding an EncryptedPackage, is refused as encrypted

refused.message: The file is an encrypted workbook. Remove its password in Excel (File, Info, Protect Workbook, Encrypt with Password) and save it again.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: an encrypted workbook is told from a legacy one when its directory spans more than one sector

refused.message: The file is an encrypted workbook. Remove its password in Excel (File, Info, Protect Workbook, Encrypt with Password) and save it again.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types">

  <Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml"/>
  <Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<workbook xmlns="{Main}" xmlns:r="{Rel}"><sheets><sheet name="Sheet1" sheetId="1" r:id="rId1"/></sheets></workbook>

refused.message: The workbook is saved as Strict Open XML, which is not read. Save it from Excel as an Excel Workbook (.xlsx).

cases.name: ADR-0330 §9: a worksheet that declares a DTD is refused, naming the Sheet and the part; no entity is expanded

book.sheet:

<!DOCTYPE lolz [<!ENTITY lol "lol"><!ENTITY lol2 "&lol;&lol;&lol;&lol;&lol;&lol;&lol;&lol;&lol;&lol;">]><worksheet xmlns="{Main}"><sheetData><row r="1"><c r="A1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>&lol2;</t></is></c></row></sheetData></worksheet>

refused.message: Sheet 'Sheet1': The part declares a document type (<!DOCTYPE), which a workbook never needs; it is not read.
